summary: The diff implements the majority of requested requirements: OurLegacy.tsx is created with the correct CTAs and styling, the /our-legacy route is registered in App.tsx, Navigation.tsx includes the 'Our Legacy' link, brand name is consistently 'Nexiris Global' in index.html and components, logo src is '/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png' in both Navigation and Footer, and FAQSection/InquiryModal/HeroSection references are updated. However, some requirements have partial or unverifiable coverage, and REQ-49 has a notable gap: the navigation does not include a dedicated 'Home' link. REQ-51 regarding HowItWorksSection.tsx resolution and backend/main.mo compilation cannot be confirmed from the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Navigation bar must display 'Home', 'Pricing', and 'Our Legacy' links
missing_requirements.reason: The Navigation.tsx diff shows 'Services', 'Trade Score', 'Pricing' (as /annual-program), and 'Our Legacy' links but no explicit 'Home' link. The requirement specifies Home, Pricing, and Our Legacy as named nav links.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure HowItWorksSection.tsx is either a complete valid component or its import is removed from Home.tsx; backend/main.mo compiles without errors
missing_requirements.reason: The diff does not show any changes to HowItWorksSection.tsx or explicit removal of its import in Home.tsx. backend/main.mo is not present in the diff at all, so its compilation status cannot be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: No occurrence of 'Nexiris Consultants LLP', 'Nexiris Consultants', or 'Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd' in any non-immutable file
missing_requirements.reason: OurLegacy.tsx intentionally references 'Nexiris Consultants' as the legacy firm name in body copy. While contextually intentional, the acceptance criterion literally states no occurrence of 'Nexiris Consultants' in non-immutable files.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes an 'Our Legacy' link in the services column
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement specified adding an Our Legacy link to the Footer services column. This was added in Footer.tsx beyond what was requested.
